name: gpu-server-setup
description: Prepare a Linux server with NVIDIA GPUs for LLM and neural-network workloads: NVIDIA driver + CUDA from the official repo, Docker Engine + NVIDIA Container Toolkit, GPU passthrough into containers, staged verification gates, and ready docker-compose presets for vLLM, Infinity, OpenWebUI and Ollama.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare a Linux server with NVIDIA GPUs for LLM workloads: driver, CUDA, Docker, GPU runtime, inference presets.
